entry_semantics.source: t5_outcomes.ENTRY_SEMANTICS — the lab's single frozen definition, imported rather than re-implemented
entry_semantics.k: sessions STRICTLY after D; entry is the open at k = 1
entry_semantics.path: k = 1..10, the entry session's own high and low INCLUDED

availability_note.sealed_state_rule: the next session open and 10 further sessions must EXIST (n_fwd >= 11)
availability_note.relation: the sealed availability is STRICTLY STRONGER than the outcome needs; it is not relaxed here

normaliser_deviation.store_has: atr_14 — the 1D bars table carries no ATR20 column
normaliser_deviation.resolution: the ATR-normalised components are built from atr_14 and NAMED MFE_ATR14_* so an ATR14 number can never be read as an ATR20 one
normaliser_deviation.impact: NONE on the capability — the registered statistic reads the return-scale pair, because the registered injection is additive in percentage points

reported: COVERAGE COUNTS ONLY — no outcome value, moment, quantile or treated/control comparison is computed or printed anywhere in this module

component_status.MFE_ATR14_LONG_10D: AUXILIARY / NON-REGISTERED — CANNOT SUBSTITUTE FOR ATR20
component_status.MFE_ATR14_SHORT_10D: AUXILIARY / NON-REGISTERED — CANNOT SUBSTITUTE FOR ATR20

registered_secondary_outcome.reason: the 1D store carries atr_14 and no ATR20 column; the registered quantity was never computed
registered_secondary_outcome.supersedes_wording: an earlier note called this a 'normaliser deviation'. It is not a deviation, it is an absence — the registered component does not exist in any form
permitted_futures: add a PIT-correct ATR20[D-1] and materialise the registered secondary exactly
leave the registered secondary formally UNAVAILABLE
registered_secondary_outcome.forbidden: a post-Y amendment redefining the ATR anchor from ATR20 to ATR14, and any use of MFE_ATR14 in the place, column or characterization wording the registered secondary would have held

capability_impact: NONE — the registered capability reads only the percentage-scale pair, because the registered injection is additive in percentage points
